title: AG60032: Crop Breeding And Biotechnological Application
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Genetic basis of resistance to diseases and insect-pests. Breeding for vertical
and horizontal resistance to diseases. Breeding for resistance to biotic and
abiotic stresses. Isolation of genes of economic importance. Gene constructs
and tissue specific expression. Direct and indirect methods of gene transfer.
Applications of genetic engineering to crop improvement: herbicide resistance,
stress resistance, oil quality, vitamins, storage protein quality, therapeutic
proteins. Transplastomic plants. Gene silencing in transgenic plants.
Terminator technology. Safety issues of GM crops.
